office: Representative, General Santos City Lone District
role: District Representative · General Santos City, Lone District
summary: General Santos representative with 58 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant measures are a petroleum VAT suspension, a plastic-bag excise tax, a government-employee PERA increase, and a customs district upgrade. Economic orientation is mildly left of center on thin evidence; other dimensions lack evidence.
caveat: Mostly tax-relief measures; sparse rubric-relevant evidence. No votes reviewed.

economic.label: Center-left
economic.rationale: Government employee PERA increase (-2) versus mixed tax measures: fuel VAT suspension and co-authored travel-tax abolition (+2) with a plastic-bag excise (-1). Net slight left lean on sparse evidence.
